_comment: TREND filter, calibrated specifically for T (T-Bank) — same grid as the root data/params/rsi_pullback/cal_trend.json: inside what uptrend the pullback is bought. Sweeps the EMA pair whose EMAFast > EMASlow condition is entry gate 3 (36 evaluations). 5/50 is a near-local trend that flips often; 20/200 is a weekly-scale trend with few but sturdier entries. EMASlow is also the most expensive parameter for warm-up — it sets the 2*need+20 floor of Lookback — so a 200-bar slow line needs a longer candle window than the volume baseline does. Everything else inherits DefaultParams. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker T -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/t/cal_trend.json -out ./reports/T_trend -months 24 -min-trades 20 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor.
